motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda, removing item 13.A. from the agenda to be discussed at a later date, and to update the minutes from the December 16, 2025, City Council Meeting to reflect that the motion on item 12.A. passed with a 3:0, not a 3:2 vote. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Routine items approved, one pulled, minutes fixed
motions.summary: The council approved its batch of routine items, pulled item 13.A. for a later date, and corrected the December 16 minutes to show a 3:0 vote, not 3:2.
motions.impact: Routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents. One item was held back and will come back on a future agenda.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New rules for fences and screening
motions.summary: The city rewrote the section of its code covering general fencing and screening; the motion itself does not spell out what the new standards say.
motions.impact: If you're planning to put up a fence or a screening wall on your property, the standards have changed — check the current rules with the city before you build.

motions.item_title: Deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: failed for lack of a majority vote, 2:3.
motions.headline: Move to reject Hidden Hollow swap outright
motions.summary: The council also took up a competing motion to deny the Hidden Hollow amenity exchange outright rather than hold it for a later date.
motions.impact: Nothing changes on the ground in Hidden Hollow. The amenity exchange is still undecided, so the plan already on the books stands for now.

motions.item_title: Table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Hidden Hollow amenity swap put on hold
motions.summary: The council set aside a proposed change to the Hidden Hollow site plan that would swap one amenity for another, without deciding it.
motions.impact: If you live in or near Hidden Hollow, the amenities in the approved plan stay as they are for now. The council can bring the item back at a later meeting.

motions.item_title: Appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Melissa Clark named Mayor Pro Tempore
motions.summary: The council appointed Councilmember Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore, the member who stands in for the mayor.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents. You may see Clark chairing a council meeting if the mayor is away.
